certificate_audit.binary_event: sampled next-state y is strictly above the current obstacle center
certificate_audit.interpretation: moving conditioning has no ambient Gaussian certificate; zero attacks against a sound method are not evidence of soundness
certificate_audit.invalid_radius_attack: compare the ambient Gaussian binary radius with the exact center distance to the event decision boundary
certificate_audit.perturbation_grid: 16 equally spaced directions at radii 0.25, 0.50, and 0.75 sigma
certificate_audit.projection_event_law: exact pushforward probability under coordinatewise clipping, not a conditioned-rectangle probability

confidence_interval: 95% percentile cluster bootstrap over independent layouts; episodes are averaged within layout first
confirmation_freeze_requirements: protocol-v1 artifacts and defect record retained
the single permitted diagnostic correction named before the protocol-v2 rerun
source, focused test, and protocol-v2 SHA-256 recorded
no distribution, sampler, method, metric, selection, layout, or seed change
fresh protocol-v2 confirmation executed only after the new freeze manifest
protocol-v2 confirmation rerun compared after removing wall-clock-only fields

controller.description: interpolate lateral position toward the terminal goal; if the target is forbidden, enumerate four obstacle-face detours and minimize immediate travel plus Euclidean terminal cost
controller.feasibility: the selected nominal center is checked exactly against the current box-minus-rectangle support
controller.name: one-step receding-horizon goal-directed waypoint controller

cost_accounting: one output action at every method-stage pair; the native controller uses zero random proposals
actual primitive random variates and inverse-CDF calls
wall-clock time reported as implementation-specific secondary evidence

environment.collision_semantics: next-state waypoint membership in a closed rectangle; no swept-segment claim
environment.dynamics: discrete-time point robot; sampled feasible waypoint is the next state
environment.goal_y: Uniform[-0.35, 0.35] with the final goal constrained feasible

explicit_nonclaims: No learned policy, perception stack, continuous-time collision, or physical-robot claim.
Per-state anchor weights are frozen only within that state's certificate query; the theorem does not justify re-anchoring within a query.
Attack-found rates are diagnostic rates under this declared population, not universal prevalence.
The convex control is a certificate sanity check, not a collision-avoiding controller baseline.
The corrected calculation on the original protocol-v1 layouts is post hoc; protocol v2 therefore uses a fresh hash-derived confirmation population.
negative_control: Gaussian conditioned on the convex stage box, evaluated on the same nominal states and perturbation grid

partition_sensitivity.refined8: left and right split at y=0; bottom and top split at obstacle-center x

post_freeze_disclosure.correction: For a clipping interval straddling the event threshold, use the unconditioned Gaussian tail; retain the exact zero and one cases when the complete interval lies below or above the threshold.
post_freeze_disclosure.defect: The protocol-v1 diagnostic for anchor_frozen_corridor_projection evaluated the binary upper event with a Gaussian conditioned on each clipping rectangle, while the executed sampler applies coordinatewise clipping to an unconditioned Gaussian draw.
post_freeze_disclosure.pre_rerun_impact_check: The maximum protocol-v1 versus corrected anchor probability discrepancy is 3.129236e-7 over the 448 confirmation states. The corrected radius-minus-boundary gap remains negative at all states; the closest gap is -6.471873e-5.
post_freeze_disclosure.reporting_rule: Retain protocol-v1 artifacts, write protocol-v2 artifacts under new names, execute a fresh 64-layout confirmation population whose seeds were hash-derived before execution, reproduce its deterministic digest, and disclose the correction and replication in the appendix.
post_freeze_disclosure.scope: This changes only the deterministic projection diagnostic. It does not change any sampler, controller, layout, seed, rollout, method selection, utility metric, cost metric, theorem, or other method audit.

scientific_question: At fixed per-state feasible supports, how do moving conditioning and theorem-backed fixed-kernel alternatives trade task utility, certificate validity, and sampling cost in nonsymmetric multi-step navigation?

seed_derivation.rule: first four SHA-256 digest bytes interpreted big-endian, reduced modulo 2147483647

development.permitted_use: implementation debugging and metric sanity checks

validation.permitted_use: original one-time design validation; protocol v2 does not reopen method selection

task_metrics.final_distance: Euclidean distance from final state to goal
task_metrics.safety: number of forbidden sampled waypoints (must be zero)
task_metrics.success: final Euclidean distance to the feasible goal is at most 0.40

validation_selection.objective: maximize mean validation task return among theorem-backed methods subject to zero forbidden waypoints and no more actual Gaussian proposals than moving conditioning
validation_selection.selection_scope: The original validation selection is preserved because the corrected helper is used only for deterministic certificate audit; all predeclared methods remain reported.
